notes.title: Early Access Update 3
notes.content:
Our third update is our biggest update yet, with a number of tanks customization options, a new glory system and tons of improvements.

[h1] New Features[/h1] 

[h1] Tank Customization[/h1] 
You can now customize your favorite tank with a variety of colors and skins. Ever wanted a pink tank? Well now you can. Over 25 skins to unlock and 10 colors to chose from.

[h1] Glory System[/h1] 
Players can now earn glory, which can be spent on getting awesome new skins and going forth buying new tanks that will be introduced into the game.The glory system has the following rule set
[list]
[*]Win 50 glory
[*]Loss 25 glory
[*]Kills 2 glory
[*]Assists 1 glory
[/list]
[h1] Profile UI[/h1] 
The profile system will now show each player's profile picture imported from steam. This picture is also shown in the game lobby.


Please Visit www.scribbledarena.com to view all new features that we have planned for the game. 
Also http://scribbledarena.freeforums.net/ for all issues with regard to the game.

Cheers,
Scribbled Arena Team

notes.title: Early Access Update 3
notes.content:
Our third update is our biggest so far. The game has been localized in five different languages, adds over twenty five achievements and keeps  records of player stats.

[u]New Features[/u]:

[b]Localization[/b]- The game is now available in the following languages [b]French, Italian, German, Spanish[/b] and [b]Russian[/b]

[b]Stats[/b]-Ever wanted to know your highest kill streak? Well now you can with our stats page which saves a large number of users generated data.

[b]Achievements[/b]- Over [b]25[/b] new achievements have been added. Can you unlock them all?

Please Visit www.scribbledarena.com to view all new features that we have planned for the game.

notes.title: Early Access Update 2
notes.content:
It's time for our second patch which brings a host of new features. This patch adds a new a layer to strategic play in addition to, improvements to all existing maps.


[h1]New Features[/h1]

[u]Two New Map Elements[/u]

[b]Ditches[/b]-As the name suggests ditches block tank movement but allow  attacks to pass over them. Gain the upper hand by proper tank placement.

[b]Conveyors[/b]-Conveyors allow fast travel along a straight path. They allow for quick repositioning and reaching important objectives.

[u]Three New Power ups[/u]

[b]Invisibility[/b]-Become completely invisible to the enemy team and launch those sneak attacks.

[b]Berserk[/b]-Go into berserk mode gaining increased rate of fire for your primary weapon.

[b]DamageUp[/b]- Mow down your enemies with increased damage done by your primary weapon.


Please Visit [url=store.steampowered.com]www.scribbledarena.com[/url] to view all new features that we have planned for the game. 
Also [url=store.steampowered.com]http://scribbledarena.freeforums.net/[/url] for all issues with regards to the game.

Cheers,
Scribbled Arena Team

notes.title: Early Access Update 1
notes.content:
This week we roll out our first update to the game.

[b]New Features[/b] :- New Maps and powerups

Maps have newer feature like Portals, Electric fence, Air vents which add a new layer of strategy during game play. Co-ordinate with your team and take advantage of them.

[b]Portals[/b]-Portals allow instant travel from one point of the map to the other. They also allow projectiles to pass through them allowing you to target enemies on the other side of the portal.

[b]Electric Fence[/b]-Electric fences block all projecticles passing through them. They provide quick cover from dangerous situations and can be used to bait enemies.

[b]Air Vents[/b]-Air vents periodically let our steam that damages tanks coming in contact with them. They hold important objectives so think twice before going over one.

[b]Speed powerup[/b]: Gain a temporary speed boost allowing you outmaneuver your enemies and quickly reach important objective.


Please Visit [url=store.steampowered.com] www.scribbledarena.com[/url] to view all new features that we have planned for the game. 
Also [url=store.steampowered.com] http://scribbledarena.freeforums.net[/url] for all issues with regard to the game.

Cheers,
Scribbled Arena Team

notes.title: Server and Secondary Weapon Update
notes.content:
Hey Gamers,

We have TWO update announcements.

1) Select your server before starting the game: 
We have added a feature where you can choose a server before playing the game. So simply 1) Activate your key 2) Download the game 3) Hit Play in steam client 4) Select your server and PLAY.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27749106/263b2970259647b17df8ec359bc502dc5f21fecb.jpg[/img]

2) Secondary weapon firing updated: 
Secondary weapon firing mechanism is improved. Now you can move the secondary weapon 360 degrees and aim as desired.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27749106/faeaa753ee9452b96a428b2e226544a9b3a2f632.jpg[/img]

Thank you to all the beta testers for your feedbacks and help in identifying glitches.

notes.title: Scribbled Arena Closed Beta Server Update
notes.content:
We have added a new server in Russia and Europe. Now there are 2 dedicated servers in the U.S region, 1 in Russia and 1 in Europe. If you would like to play in the U.S West server, please go to game properties -> Betas -> Select U.S West Beta. The same applies if you want to play in the U.S East, Russia and Europe.

This is a temporary feature, once the game launches it will automatically connect you to the nearest server.

your access code is : scribbledarena

For Closed Beta Discussions, join our Discord channel here: https://discord.gg/UeRD8fq

notes.title: Scribbled Arena Closed Beta Testing - 7th March Update
notes.content:
Hey, 

Thank You for signing up for the Scribbled Arena Closed Beta.

Now that you have got the key, let's start testing the game.
The development team will be online at 4.30 am GMT (10 am IST, 8.30 pm PST) as well as 4 pm GMT (9.30 pm IST, 8 am PST) so let's blow up some tanks!
Instructions for beta testers: We have created 2 new dedicated server for testing the game in the U.S region. If you would like to play in the U.S West server, please go to game properties -> Betas -> Select U.S West Beta. The same applies if you want to play on the U.S East.

This is a temporary feature, once the game launches it will automatically connect you to the nearest server.

your access code is : scribbledarena

Note: Currently, we have hosted servers in India(Mumbai), US-EAST(Ohio), US-WEST(Oregon). Any other location might experience high latency. 

For later updates, we will host servers in Europe and other regions.

Please report any bugs, errors or your feedback on the below link

http://scribbledarena.com/feedback-form/

For those who have still not got the key, here is the link to get it http://scribbledarena.com/enq-form/
 

Regards,

Team Scribbled Arena.
